en.name: Mona
en.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself); you learn if they are the same alignment as you. If you choose an Archon, you register as evil until you choose a non-Archon player.

revisions.v1: Each night, choose a player (not yourself); you learn if they are the same alignment as you. If you choose an Archon, you register as evil until you choose a non-Archon player.

en.flavor: he stars glitter like diamonds in the night sky, and the destiny of the world is already written in the stars.
en.firstNightReminder: Wake the Mona. Point at any players except themself.  If they shake their head no, nothing happens. Put the Mona to sleep. If they point a players, either nod your head yes or shake your head no. Put the Mona to sleep. if they point [Archons] ,places a "Register as Evil" reminder mark next to Mona's character mark until next time you choose.
